notes: VAT 18% on taxable supplies in Mainland Tanzania (VAT Act Cap. 148, s.5). Gold to the Bank of Tanzania and to licensed refineries is zero-rated (Finance Act 2024, ss.55C/55D); precious metals exempt only at designated buying stations/Mineral and Gem Houses (Schedule Part I item 25, as amended 2024 - refineries deleted). EAC CET HS 7108 line not readable - duty null.

sources.name: Tanzania Revenue Authority - Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 148 R.E. 2023
sources.quote: The amount of value added tax payable shall be calculated by multiplying the value of the supply or import by the value added tax rate, which shall be eighteen percent.
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28 via live browser: s.5(1) fixes the VAT rate at eighteen percent; Schedule Part I item 25 (R.E. 2023 text) exempts precious metals at refineries, buying stations or Mineral and Gem Houses - see Finance Act 2024 for the 2024 amendment.

sources.name: Tanzania Revenue Authority - Finance Act, 2024 (No. 6 of 2024)
sources.quote: 55C. A supply of gold to the Bank of Tanzania shall be zero rated.
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: s.109 adds ss.55C/55D zero-rating gold supplied to the Bank of Tanzania and to licensed refineries in Mainland Tanzania; s.110(d) deletes 'refineries' from Schedule Part I item 25.
